subject: RivetAI discovery follow-up & proposed launch pathway
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@rivetai.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@rivetai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap + proposed launch pathway

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Below is a short recap and a proposed 4-week trial path so we can validate value quickly. Please flag anything we missed or want revised.

Summary of pain points you shared
- High inference latency on current provider for peak question volumes (spikes during support hours).
- Cost unpredictability tied to long-tail prefixes and repeated context re-send.
- Need for PII-safe logging and a short retention window for analytics.
- Desire to measure quality on intent classification + retrieval-augmented answers before committing to wider rollout.

Goals for the trial
- Validate 95th/99th percentile latency under a 300 TPS burst profile (target 95th < 200ms).
- Improve intent classification precision by >= 6% over current baseline on your labeled set.
- Demonstrate prompt set stability: fewer than 5% regressions across a 200-sample eval set.

Proposed 4-week trial scope
Week 0 (prep): access, sample data ingest (S3), and baseline run; we provision a dedicated test pool to stabilize latency.
Week 1–2: run prompt/eval suite against baseline and tune batching/kv cache; collect telemetry.
Week 3: joint review of metrics, edge-case prompt fixes, and run final eval.
Week 4: acceptance review and handoff to your SREs for integration plan.

Ownership (proposed)
- Redwood AE: Irene Choi (me) — commercial lead + exec updates.
- Solutions Eng: Karthik Iyer — integration, prompt tuning, eval harness.
- Customer Success: Ben Carter — onboarding and post-trial handoff.
- RivetAI: Ava Reynolds — product owner; Tom Keller — SRE lead; procurement contact to be shared for contract steps.

Immediate asks / access needed
1) Short list sample dataset (S3 link preferred) or 1,000 de-identified rows in CSV — to mount for eval.
2) Network reachability: if you prefer VPC peering, share the VPC CIDR + point of contact; otherwise we can use short-lived API keys and IP allowlist.
3) Confirm retention policy (30 days? 7 days?) and whether you need logs redaction at source.

Attachments included with this email: RWI_POC_Outline_v1.pdf (outline + metric rubrics), MVP_prompt_set.csv (starter prompts and eval labels), SOC2_excerpt.txt (security highlights).

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-06-14 10:00 AM PT — if that works for you we'll send an invite and a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@rivetai.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap + proposed launch pathway

Thanks Irene — this is helpful and mostly aligned with our needs. A couple quick clarifications: 
1) For data retention, our security policy prefers 7 days for raw logs; derived analytics can keep longer — I'll confirm the exact phrasing with security.
2) On throughput — the 300 TPS burst is a good stress target; curious how you simulate user think-time vs synthetic burst.

I'll loop in procurement (Lori) and our legal lead for standard NDAs and the trial addendum. Ava and I can provide a small, de-identified dataset by EOD tomorrow.

Also, can you add a short note about telemetry access (do you provide a dashboard or raw export)? That will help our SRE plan.

On availability: Tue Jun 14 10am PT should work for Ava and me — go ahead and send the invite.

Tom
Tom Keller

Perfect — thanks Ava & Tom. Looping Lori for procurement logistics.

Quick answers and next steps: 
- Eval harness schema: Karthik will share a minimal CSV template and a short README (labels: id, prompt, expected_label, candidate_response, score). Karthik — sending that by EOD.
- Test pool: we'll provision a short-lived dedicated test pool for the trial (isolated tenancy) to hit the latency targets; that will require a short IP allowlist or VPC peering. Ben, Karthik: please coordinate the provisioning ticket and network checklist.
- Telemetry: we'll provide both a Grafana dashboard link and a daily CSV export (raw telemetry + aggregated percentiles). Link and export details included in the kickoff doc.

Kickoff details confirmed:
- When: Tue 2027-06-14 10:00 AM PT (we'll send a calendar invite after this email).
- Agenda (30m): 1) introductions + success criteria, 2) brief infra handoff (network/auth), 3) dataset mapping & eval plan, 4) next steps and milestones.

Attachments (again): RWI_POC_Outline_v1.pdf, MVP_prompt_set.csv.

Proposed acceptance gate (end of week 4): 3x checks — latency SLO, precision uplift vs baseline, and no critical regressions in the prompt eval (see attachment rubric).

If anyone needs a different kickoff time, tell us and we'll adjust. We'll follow up with a calendar invite and a short runbook (access + contact points).

Thanks all — looking forward to getting started.
